newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada 91-day T-bill yields avg 3.196 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada 91-day T-bill yields avg 3.196 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Canada said the average yield at this week's auction of C$2.4 billion of 91-day Government of Canada treasury bills due July 24, 1997 was 3.196 percent, down from 3.198 percent last week.

The average yield on C$1.3 billion of 182-day T-bills due October 23, 1997 was 3.632 percent, up from 3.295 percent last week, and on C$1.1 billion of 357-day T-bills due April 16, 1998 was 4.230 percent, down from 4.325 percent.
The Bank bought C$525 million three-month, C$125 million six-month and C$100 million one-year bills. It holds C$600 billion of C$6.6 billion bills due May 1.
